title: Case 03: Room 417
subtitle: A software founder dies inside a hotel room chained from the inside. No one enters during the murder window.
loop_reset_text: The hotel clock flips from 2:17 AM back to 1:40 AM. Room 417 seals itself again.

hall.name: Fourth-Floor Hall
hall.description: Thick carpet, silent doors and a camera watching a corridor where nobody seems to enter Room 417.

room.name: Room 417
room.description: The door chain hangs inside. The minibar is open. The room is colder than the hallway.

maintenance.name: HVAC Maintenance
maintenance.description: Filters, ducts and service controls feed the fourth floor. Someone has recently opened panel 4B.

conference.name: Conference Lounge
conference.description: Investor badges, coffee trays and private meeting schedules from the evening's conference.

sofia.name: Sofia Cross
dialogue: I met him, argued, and left. He was alive.
I wanted a divorce, not his death.

contradiction.result: Camera timing and key logs show Sofia left before the lethal system cycle. Her argument is real, but the locked-room setup predates it.

marcus.name: Marcus Vale
dialogue: The board was removing me, yes, but Adrian and I still had business to finish.
Someone used a cloned conference badge to access the service floor.

contradiction.result: Marcus's badge was cloned. The access event cannot prove he entered maintenance.

ivy.name: Ivy Chen
dialogue: Housekeeping inspected the room at six.
The minibar inventory was wrong before Adrian checked in.

contradiction.result: The housekeeping schedule and minibar discrepancy prove Room 417 was prepared hours before Adrian arrived.

noah.name: Noah Reed
dialogue: I borrowed a service tablet to fix a projector.
The same tablet can reach building controls. I did not know that.

contradiction.result: Noah's service tablet was used, but a cloned badge authenticated the command. Someone exploited his device.

elena.name: Dr. Elena Hart
dialogue: I invested in Adrian's company. That is all.
I know chemistry, so of course everyone looks at me.
Adrian discovered I had used his company to hide a toxic-materials contract.

contradiction.result: The missing filter, residue and remote HVAC command establish Elena's method: the room itself became the delivery system.

minibar.name: Minibar Inventory Gap
minibar.description: Two solvent-containing minibar items were replaced before check-in.

residue.name: Meltwater Residue
residue.description: The ice bucket contains residue that becomes dangerous when aerosolized with the missing filter compound.

keylog.name: Digital Key Log
keylog.description: No guest key opens Room 417 during the lethal window.

schedule.name: Housekeeping Schedule
schedule.description: Room 417 was serviced hours before Adrian arrived, leaving time to prepare it.

camera.name: Hallway Camera
camera.description: The corridor remains empty when the poisoning begins.

filter.name: Missing Ventilation Filter
filter.description: Panel 4B is missing a specialized filter cartridge.

tablet.name: Remote HVAC Command
tablet.description: A service tablet scheduled a 2:11 AM ventilation cycle for Room 417.

badge.name: Cloned Conference Badge
badge.description: A cloned badge authorized access under Marcus's identity.

timeline: 2:03 AM — Service tablet schedules HVAC cycle.
deduction_prompt: Who prepared Room 417 so the victim could die without the killer entering during the murder window?
truth: Elena prepared Room 417 before Adrian checked in, using substituted minibar chemicals and a modified ventilation filter. She later used Noah's service tablet and a cloned Marcus badge to trigger the lethal HVAC cycle remotely. The locked door was genuine because the murder mechanism was already inside.
partial: You name Elena but cannot fully explain how the locked room worked. The prosecution has motive, but the mechanism remains vulnerable to doubt.
wrong: The room remains logically impossible under your theory. At 2:17 AM the hotel resets.
